errors.evidence: The description interprets the currency abbreviation "щ.д." as "световни долари" (world dollars). The standard expansion of this abbreviation is "щатски долари" (US dollars).

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the countries on the y-axis are sorted in Bulgarian alphabetical order. The order shown is Сиера Леоне, Либерия, Гвинея, while the correct alphabetical order in Bulgarian is Гвинея, Либерия, Сиера Леоне.
